verdict.rationale: The firm's own Startup, Emerging & Growth Companies page explicitly lists 'Exits, including IPOs, going private, and mergers & acquisitions' and describes guiding clients from formation through growth financings to 'successful and lucrative exits,' and the llms.txt overview separately documents sell-side/buy-side Venture M&A counsel (earnouts, escrows, equity holder consents), directly matching the M&A and public-offering exit story. Missing for 10: no dedicated standalone 'IPO/public offerings' practice page or named IPO deal examples/case studies, only bundled mention alongside M&A on the general startup page.
